events.did: told Eli he was alive, noting that the word went up at the end
events.quote_anchor: “Eli. You’re alive.” The word went up at the end, caught between a statement and a question.

events.did: pointed out that Eli looked wrong, with fresh scars across his knuckles and throat and a knife in his side
events.quote_anchor: But now, fresh scars ran across his knuckles, ringed his throat, and what looked like a short knife was embedded in his side.

events.did: named the EOs who had been resurrected, saying Eli enjoyed being controlled by another EO
events.quote_anchor: “First Serena, then Stell, now Gray,” he said. “I’m starting to think you enjoy being controlled.

events.did: told Eli he was not Eli but something that had crawled into his skin
events.quote_anchor: “You’re not Eli,” said Victor, echoing the words aimed at him eighteen years ago. “You’re something that’s crawled into his skin.”

events.did: wrenched on the pain in Eli’s side and shot him in the face
events.quote_anchor: Eli took a step toward Victor, who reached out before he could take a second one and wrenched on the pain in Eli’s side

events.did: threw Eli over the chair and into the glass table, then took up the gun and the short knife
events.quote_anchor: knocking him off-balance and throwing him over the chair and into the glass table.

events.did: aimed the gun at the camera in the corner and told Gabriel to come kill him himself, then pulled the trigger and exploded it
events.quote_anchor: He swung the gun up, aiming not for Eli but the camera in the corner of the room. “Therapy requires a foundation of mutual respect,”

events.did: sank the other shard of glass into Victor’s side while Victor was delivering the message
events.quote_anchor: In the time it had taken to deliver the message, Eli was there, sinking the other shard of glass into Victor’s side.

relations.did: calls Eli his old friend and foe, and says Sydney killed him once
relations.quote_anchor: He stared across the room at his old friend—and foe—once again, in the flesh.

relations.did: is resurrected and controlled by another EO, Gabriel, who will bring Victor back after Eli kills him
relations.quote_anchor: “After I kill you,” said Eli. “He’s going to bring you back. And you’ll know what it means to bow before a higher power.”

relations.did: killed Eli once, and Victor is betting he can do it again
relations.quote_anchor: “You say that,” said Victor, “but Sydney killed you once. I’m betting I can do it again.”

relations.did: draws the distinction between EOs and everyone else, convinced that he alone was special, a sword of God and a weapon for slaying monsters
relations.quote_anchor: Eli had always made the distinction, convinced that he alone was special. A sword of God. A weapon, made for slaying monsters.

numbers.did: how long ago the words aimed at him were aimed at Victor: eighteen years ago
numbers.quote_anchor: “You’re not Eli,” said Victor, echoing the words aimed at him eighteen years ago.

numbers.did: which resurrection this was, by Victor’s count: second
numbers.quote_anchor: “Something wrong?” asked Victor. “You don’t seem to be healing quite as … gracefully. Then again,” he added, “second resurrections always come with complications.”

numbers.did: how many bullets he caught in the chest after dodging the first shot: three
numbers.quote_anchor: He dodged the first shot, caught the next three in the chest, but didn’t stop.

numbers.did: the order in which they were resurrected: First Serena, then Stell, now Gray
numbers.quote_anchor: “First Serena, then Stell, now Gray,” he said.

numbers.did: how many times Eli caught his wrist before Victor could get the gun up: a second time
numbers.quote_anchor: catching his wrist before he could get the gun up a second time, the other hand wrapping around Victor’s throat.

numbers.did: how many times Sydney had killed Eli: once
numbers.quote_anchor: “You say that,” said Victor, “but Sydney killed you once. I’m betting I can do it again.”
